coverage_claim: All 42 frozen requirements map to defined verification scenarios. Candidate results are recorded separately.

requirements.text: Transmit minimum, ordinary, and maximum non-jumbo frames.
Pad payloads shorter than 46 octets.
Generate and check Ethernet CRC-32/FCS.
Enforce the benchmark interpacket gap.
Reject truncated, oversized, and bad-FCS frames.
Preserve bytes across arbitrary ready/valid backpressure.
Support simultaneous full-duplex traffic.
Implement pause control and bounded resume.
Maintain frame and error counters with defined rollover.
Encode and decode the complete benchmark 8b/10b alphabet.
Maintain and check running disparity.
Acquire comma alignment at every bit offset.
Recognize legal ordered sets and reject malformed sets.
Establish the frozen fixed-link profile without auto-negotiation.
Detect loss of synchronization and reacquire within the bound.
Correct declared receive-pair polarity inversion.
Serialize and deserialize at 1.25 GBd without bit reordering.
Cross clock domains without byte loss or duplication.
Provide digital, PCS, and analog loopback modes.
Meet differential swing, common-mode, and crossing limits.
Meet mandatory PRBS and hostile-pattern eye limits.
Bound deterministic jitter and duty-cycle distortion.
Meet sensitivity and common-mode input limits.
Meet the declared jitter-tolerance mask.
Acquire lock across frequency offset and phase conditions.
Track modulation without false or stuck lock.
Provide bounded programmable swing, threshold, bias, and loop controls.
Use safe reset codes with calibration margin away from trim rails.
Meet power, startup, disable, and deterministic restart bounds.
Pass every mandatory PVT, load, and bounded-model case.
Bound transmit aggressor coupling into the active receiver.
Transfer packets from host TX stream through the serial peer.
Transfer packets from the serial peer to the host RX stream.
Sustain simultaneous bidirectional traffic with errors injected.
Recover from reset and line loss without emitting a false good frame.
Produce zero-error DRC and unique LVS evidence.
Repeat critical tests on post-fill full-RC extraction.
Pass density, antenna, IR-drop, and current-density checks.
Check differential parasitic imbalance and top-level pin identity.
Bind every result to candidate, PDK, tool, fixture, seed, and corner identities.
Fail closed on missing, stale, partial, non-finite, or wrong-view evidence.
Do not convert benchmark passage into compliance or silicon claims.
